title: The Singhs Divide into Four Contingents

blocks.text: The Singhs answer the pressure not by passivity but by movement, started pouncing upon the Muslim troops and blocking their movement on the main highways whenever an opening appears.
To keep the struggle flexible, they divided themselves into four contingents with the understanding that other contingents would rush immediately to its rescue whenever one unit was cornered.
That tactical choice leads directly to the next crisis, because one body is driven toward Bhagwant’s mansion on the banks of the Ravi, where the Mughals believe they can finally trap them.
